title: Do not query downstream services inside batch loops
description: Enriches each order by calling the inventory service one record at a time.
issue_title: The design creates an N-plus-1 network pattern
issue_description: Per-record downstream calls add latency and amplify dependency load as the batch size grows.
issue_suggestion: Batch the dependency call or preload the related data once for the whole set.
issue_code: stock_by_sku = inventory_api.bulk_get([order.sku for order in orders])

title: Separate command validation from execution side effects
description: Creates a shipment and sends notifications in one function.
issue_title: Validation and side effects are tightly coupled
issue_description: Blending policy checks with effects makes the workflow harder to reason about and retry safely.
issue_suggestion: Isolate command validation, then execute side effects within a clearer workflow boundary.

title: Use durable scheduling for delayed work
description: Stores reminder jobs in process memory until they are due.
issue_title: Delayed work is lost on process restart
issue_description: In-memory scheduling cannot survive deploys, crashes, or horizontal scaling.
issue_suggestion: Use a durable job store or external scheduler for delayed tasks.

title: Do not make analytics a write-path dependency
description: Creates a subscription only after the analytics profile is synced.
issue_title: Non-critical analytics blocks the core transaction
issue_description: A reporting dependency should not determine the availability of the main business operation.
issue_suggestion: Move analytics emission off the critical path.

title: Model quota checks with a consistent source of truth
description: Reads quota from cache and usage from a different store in the same request.
code:
def can_create_project(user_id):
    limit = cache.get(f'quota:{user_id}')
    used = database.count_projects(user_id)
    return used < limit
issue_title: Quota decision spans inconsistent data sources
issue_description: Reading the limit and usage from different consistency domains can make enforcement unreliable.
issue_suggestion: Make the quota decision against one coherent source of truth or transaction boundary.

title: Prefer append-only event logs for replayable workflows
description: Updates a single status field as an order moves through states.
issue_title: State transitions are not replayable or auditable
issue_description: Only the latest status remains, which makes debugging process history harder.
issue_suggestion: Record immutable state transition events when replayability matters.

title: Keep synchronous APIs within a clear latency budget
description: Builds a settings page by reading ten services one after another.
code:
def settings_page(user_id):
    profile = profile_api.get(user_id)
    billing = billing_api.get(user_id)
    alerts = alerts_api.get(user_id)
    teams = teams_api.get(user_id)
    permissions = perms_api.get(user_id)
    return {
        'profile': profile,
        'billing': billing,
        'alerts': alerts,
        'teams': teams,
        'permissions': permissions,
    }
issue_title: Serial dependency fan-out exceeds a reasonable latency budget
issue_description: Each additional blocking call makes the endpoint slower and more failure-prone.
issue_suggestion: Parallelize independent calls or precompose the data elsewhere.

title: Avoid coupling write success to cache fill success
description: Creates a product and immediately writes it into Redis before returning.
code:
def create_product(payload):
    product = db.insert_product(payload)
    redis.set(f'product:{product.id}', serialize(product))
    return product
issue_title: Cache warm-up is treated as part of the write transaction
issue_description: A cache outage should not block creation of the canonical record.
issue_suggestion: Make cache fill best-effort or asynchronous after the primary write succeeds.

title: Prefer contract boundaries over direct table sharing between services
description: A reporting service reads the billing service tables directly.
code:
def monthly_report(db):
    return db.query('SELECT * FROM billing_invoices')
issue_title: Service boundaries are bypassed through shared tables
issue_description: Direct cross-service table reads create hidden coupling and make schema changes risky.
issue_suggestion: Expose the data through a contract or replicated read model instead.

title: Use explicit ownership for cross-cutting data cleanup
description: Deletes a user and relies on every service to notice later.
issue_description: Dependent systems may keep stale personal data or broken references if ownership is not coordinated.
issue_suggestion: Define an explicit deletion workflow with ownership for downstream cleanup.
